settings.heading: Nordik Radiant and Sinopé Thermostats Now Compatible with Hilo

settings.text:
We have some exciting news to share with you!

Nordik Radiant and Sinopé thermostats are now compatible with Hydro-Québec’s Hilo service*. They are even eligible for a bonus of up to $700 when you subscribe to Hilo with a one-year commitment.

Even better, the offer applies both to the thermostats you already own and to any new ones you might want to add!

* Sinopé GT130 gateway required for Zigbee thermostats and the Hilo gateway.

settings.content:
• Nordik Radiant TH1420ZB Thermostats
  • Sinopé GT130 Gateway
  • Sinopé TH1400WF Thermostats
  • Sinopé Calypso Water Heater Controller

settings.text: Hilo, a subsidiary of Hydro-Québec, provides smart solutions to help you optimize your energy usage and participate in energy-saving challenges for cash rewards.

settings.heading: Join Hilo challenges!
settings.text: Up to 30 times each winter, Hilo will send a notification through the app inviting you to take on a challenge. This means lowering your electricity use for a few hours during peak demand periods
How to join Hilo and benefit from the bonus?

settings.heading: The steps to follow to benefit from the rebates

settings.text:
1. Purchase or verify the compatibility of your Sinopé-compatible devices.
  2. Add your devices to the Sinopé Neviweb app and select the Hilo option in Éco Sinopé.
  3. Receive your bonus from Hydro-Québec in the following weeks.
3 reasons to connect your Sinopé compatible devices to Hilo

Did you know that you could cut up to 25% off your annual electricity costs just by swapping out your old thermostats for Sinopé-compatible smart thermostats?

These devices are designed to meet top energy efficiency standards while giving you greater control and comfort (1). You'll reduce unnecessary energy use, for instance, by automatically lowering the temperature when you're away, thanks to automations tailored to your schedule, preferences, and lifestyle.

Plus, by connecting these thermostats to Hilo, you’re joining a larger collective effort to balance energy demand during winter peaks through Hilo challenges, helping to prevent grid overload.

settings.heading: 2. Even more savings with Hilo challenges

settings.text:
By connecting your devices, you will have the opportunity to participate in energy reduction challenges between December and March. The concept is straightforward: the more you reduce your energy usage during the challenges, the more cash rewards you can earn. The average for the 2023-2024 season was $135 in savings by participating in these challenges (2).

Prior to each challenge, you'll receive a notification letting you know that a peak event is approaching, giving you the choice to participate or opt out based on your preference (participation is automatic unless you choose to decline). During the challenge, Hilo will reduce the temperature on your thermostats by 3 to 6 degrees, depending on the option you’ve set, and will return it to your normal settings once the challenge is over.

If you’re already a fan of the free Neviweb app and its features, there’s no need to worry. You can still use Hilo to manage your devices during winter peak events, while continuing to enjoy Neviweb’s full range of features—such as automations, schedules, geofencing, and scenes—for controlling your devices outside of peak times

Saving has never been simpler! Get a $70 rebate for each compatible Sinopé thermostat by connecting them to Hydro-Québec's Hilo app easily and at no cost. This offer applies both to thermostats you already own and to any new purchases (3):

  • Smart thermostat for electric baseboards
  • Smart thermostat for heated floors
  • Low voltage smart thermostat

Visit this page to see the list of compatible devices and follow the 3 easy steps to claim your rebate. You’ll receive your bonus within a few weeks after connecting your devices to Hilo, and you can track your rebate anytime in the Hilo app.

(1)Save up to 25% on your bill simply by replacing old roller thermostats that were kept at a constant temperature of 22 degrees with smart thermostats.Sinopé smart thermostats all comply with CSA-C828-19 certification, which includes the highest standards in energy efficiency and offer superior control quality.

(2) Source from the Hilo website by Hydro-Québec.

(3) You will be able to benefit from $70 per smart thermostat - electric baseboard and heated floor (limit of 10) and low voltage (limit of 2) per address.
